_comment: Item data. kind: bag (holds `slots` slots) | notebook (holds `pages` notes, one per page) | heal (heals `heal_halves` halves of a heart). size_in_bag: slots the item takes inside a bag; for a bag, size_in_bag > 0 means it can be carried inside a bag with size_in_bag 0 (one level only), keeping its own slots and contents. stack_max: how many of one item share a slot.
